protocol.name: Protein Builder Cloning Assembly
protocol.purpose: Design cloning primers and PCR setup for a Protein Builder assembled construct.

steps.text: Amplify fragments: PCR-amplify all fragments using the overlap-bearing primer set.
Assemble reaction: Combine fragments in a Gibson-style assembly reaction using the planned overlap order.
Transform and recover: Transform the assembly reaction into competent cells and recover colonies.
Validate junctions: Screen every junction by colony PCR and sequence through the assembled insert.

protocol.troubleshooting: If primer design is infeasible, adjust the selected backbone, fragment order, or assembly strategy.
